source: Deterministically generated OHLC sample bundled with Market Signal Lab for offline multi-regime examples and tests.
limitations: Synthetic rows are not broker, exchange, fund-provider, vendor, or live-feed data.
Regime labels are fixture scenarios for testing report behavior, not market classifications, predictions, live-trading signals, or recommendations.
Rows do not model slippage, liquidity, taxes, financing costs, corporate actions, survivorship effects, or market impact.
Use only for deterministic research artifact checks; do not use for advice, recommendations, predictions, or market claims.

regimes.description: Monotonic upward path used to exercise trend-following examples.
assumptions: Close prices increase every sample period by construction.
Open prices equal the prior close after the first row.
High and low prices are synthetic padding around open and close.

regimes.description: Alternating path that ends near flat after repeated reversals.
assumptions: Close prices alternate around the starting level by construction.
Open prices equal the prior close after the first row.
High and low prices are synthetic padding around open and close.

regimes.description: Decline followed by recovery for drawdown diagnostics.
assumptions: Close prices fall first and then recover by construction.
Open prices equal the prior close after the first row.
High and low prices are synthetic padding around open and close.
